items.source_he: מִי שֶׁרוֹצֶה לְדַבֵּק אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, עַד שֶׁיֵּלֵךְ בְּמַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ מֵהֵיכָל אֶל הֵיכָל וְיִרְאֶה אֶת הַהֵיכָלוֹת בְּעֵינֵי הַשֵּׂכֶל, יִשְׁמֹר אֶת עַצְמוֹ מִלּוֹמַר שֶׁקֶר אֲפִלּוּ בְּטָעוּת.
items.source_en: 1. One who wants to attach himself to the Blessed G-d, to the extent that he can traverse with his thoughts from Haichal to Haichal (chamber to chamber), and to see the haichaloas (chambers) with the eyes of the intellect, must guard himself from saying falsehood, even by mistake.
items.animation_prompt: Create a 6-8 second vertical contemplative Torah animation for Sefer Hamidos, Truth teaching 1. Use the supplied teaching image as the exact text/title card reference; keep all Hebrew/English text crisp and unchanged. Animate only atmosphere: soft Jerusalem golden light, gentle page glow, subtle moving clouds, candle flicker, floating sparks of emunah, slow parallax over ancient sefer pages. Feature an authentic joyful Na Nach Breslov presence without distortion: a modest Jewish learner or dancer wearing a kippah/beanie clearly reading כיפה של נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן or Na Nach, with optional all-white Na Nach clothing or colorful Jerusalem garb, not only black-hat imagery. Theme: One who wants to attach himself to the Blessed G-d, to the extent that he can traverse with his thoughts from Haichal to Haichal (chamber to chamber), and to see the haichaloas (chambers) with the eyes of the intellect, must guard himself from saying falsehood, even by mistake.. Avoid horror, mockery, women singers, random fake Hebrew, misspelled Na Nach, or changing the teaching text. End on a calm readable freeze-frame.
